Class Types Explained

Hatha Basics

Beginner

A gentle introduction to yoga fundamentals. Perfect for beginners and those looking to build a solid foundation. We focus on proper alignment and breathing techniques.

Best for: Beginners, those returning to yoga, or anyone seeking a slower pace.

Vinyasa Flow

Intermediate

A dynamic, flowing class that links breath with movement. Vinyasa builds strength, flexibility, and cardiovascular endurance through continuous sequences.

Best for: Those with some yoga experience looking for a more active practice.

Power Yoga

Advanced

An intense, challenging class designed to build muscle strength and tone. Power Yoga incorporates faster-paced flows and holds that demand focus and endurance.

Best for: Experienced practitioners seeking a vigorous, strength-building practice.

Yin Yoga

Beginner

A slow, meditative practice where poses are held for several minutes. Yin targets deep connective tissues and promotes relaxation and mindfulness.

Best for: Anyone seeking stress relief, improved flexibility, and a contemplative practice.

Restorative Yoga

Beginner

A deeply relaxing practice using props and longer holds. Restorative Yoga supports healing and recovery while promoting inner peace.

Best for: Recovery, stress management, and those with injuries or limited mobility.

Sunrise Hatha

Beginner

Start your day energized with a gentle morning practice. This class combines basic poses with pranayama (breathing) to awaken mind and body.

Best for: Early risers seeking a peaceful start to the day, all levels welcome.

Lunch Flow

Beginner

A 60-minute mid-day refresh perfect for office workers and busy schedules. Energizing yet accessible, with a focus on releasing tension.

Best for: Professionals, all levels, anyone looking to recharge during their workday.

Gentle Yoga

Beginner

A calming, supportive practice ideal for building confidence. Gentle Yoga incorporates modifications and props to make poses accessible to everyone.

Best for: Seniors, injury recovery, pregnancy, or anyone preferring a slower, nurturing pace.

Our Teachers

Meet the experienced and passionate instructors at Serenity Yoga Studio. Each teacher brings unique expertise, compassion, and dedication to their practice and teaching. Whether you're just beginning or deepening your practice, our teachers are here to guide you toward greater peace and strength.

Our Teaching Team

Maya Patel

RYT-500 • E-RYT

Specialties: Hatha, Vinyasa Flow, Alignment

Maya has been teaching yoga for 12 years and holds a 500-hour teaching certification. Her approach combines traditional alignment principles with dynamic movement, creating accessible classes for all levels. Maya believes yoga is a journey of self-discovery and compassion.

James Chen

RYT-200 • Yin Certified

Specialties: Yin, Restorative, Meditation

James brings 9 years of teaching experience with a focus on the slower, deeper practices. His classes are designed to release tension, calm the nervous system, and cultivate inner peace. James emphasizes breath awareness and mindful presence in every session.

Sophie Rodriguez

RYT-300 • Yoga for Athletes

Specialties: Power Yoga, Athletic Flow, Core Strength

Sophie brings high energy and athletic training experience to her dynamic classes. With 8 years in yoga education, she specializes in building strength, flexibility, and resilience. Sophie's classes challenge both body and mind, perfect for those seeking an energizing practice.

David Kumar

RYT-200 • Prenatal Yoga Specialist

Specialties: Prenatal, Beginner, Gentle Flow

David has dedicated 7 years to helping expectant parents and beginners find their yoga practice. His warm, nurturing teaching style creates a safe space for new students. David specializes in prenatal yoga and gentle practices that honor the body's natural rhythms.

Elena Moreno

RYT-500 • Ashtanga Authorized

Specialties: Ashtanga, Advanced Alignment, Teacher Training

Elena is an Ashtanga-authorized instructor with 15 years of dedicated practice and teaching. She leads both structured Ashtanga classes and advanced alignment workshops. Elena's philosophy centers on discipline, breath, and the transformative power of a consistent practice.

Marcus Thompson

RYT-200 • Yoga for Seniors

Specialties: Seniors, Gentle Therapeutic, Mobility

Marcus brings 6 years of experience working with older adults and those managing chronic conditions. His therapeutic approach focuses on maintaining mobility, balance, and quality of life. Marcus creates a supportive environment where all students feel valued and capable.

Our Philosophy

At Serenity Yoga Studio, we believe that yoga is for everyone. Our teachers are united by a commitment to creating an inclusive, non-judgmental space where students of all ages, abilities, and backgrounds can explore their practice. We honor the ancient traditions of yoga while making it accessible and relevant to modern life.

Each teacher brings their own unique voice and experience, but we all share these core values:

  • Compassion: For ourselves and others on the mat and in the world
  • Authenticity: Teaching from lived experience and genuine passion
  • Inclusivity: Welcoming all bodies, minds, and spirits
  • Safety: Providing clear alignment cues and modifications for all levels
  • Growth: Continuous learning and deepening of our own practice

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I pause or cancel my membership?

Yes. Monthly Unlimited and Annual Memberships can be cancelled anytime with no penalty. We just ask for 7 days notice. If you need to pause your membership temporarily, contact us to discuss options.

Do class packages expire?

Class packages are valid for 60 days from the date of purchase. After that, unused classes expire. However, you can request a one-time 30-day extension if needed—just ask at the studio.

Can I share my membership or class package?

Class packages can be shared or transferred to friends and family. Memberships are non-transferable and linked to your account for booking purposes. However, you may bring a guest to class on an occasional basis.

How do I book classes?

Members can book classes online through our website or by visiting the studio. Drop-in and class package holders can book directly at the studio or call us at (503) 555-1234. We recommend booking in advance, especially for popular classes.

Is there a contract or commitment period?

No contracts required. Our Monthly Unlimited and Annual Membership are month-to-month or year-long, but you can cancel anytime. Class packages and drop-in rates have no commitment at all.

Do you offer refunds?

Refunds are available for unused classes or memberships cancelled within 7 days of purchase. Please contact us at hello@serenity-yoga.local or (503) 555-1234 to request a refund.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and direct bank transfer. Monthly recurring memberships are charged on the same date each month. You'll receive a confirmation email after each payment.

Are there additional fees?

No hidden fees. The price you see is what you pay. Some specialty workshops or events may have additional fees, but regular classes included with your membership are always free.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I book a class?

You can book a class by visiting our class schedule page. Most classes require advance registration through our online booking system, which you'll receive access to when you sign up for membership. Drop-in classes are also available for select sessions.

What should I bring to class?

Please bring your own yoga mat, although we have mats available to borrow if needed. Wear comfortable clothing that allows you to move freely. We recommend bringing a water bottle to stay hydrated during class.

Do you offer beginner classes?

Yes! We offer classes for all levels, including beginner-friendly sessions. Check our class schedule for difficulty levels and descriptions, or reach out to us directly to find the perfect class for you.

Can I get a trial class?

Absolutely! We offer a free trial class for new students. Fill out the contact form above or call us to schedule your first visit. We also offer a 7-day introductory pass for just $29.

What is your cancellation policy?

Class cancellations can be made up to 2 hours before class start time through our online booking system. For membership cancellations, we require 30 days written notice. Visit our pricing page for full details.

Do you offer private sessions?

Yes, we offer private one-on-one yoga sessions with our instructors. These can be customized to your needs and goals. Contact us directly for pricing and availability.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I book a class?

You can book a class by visiting our class schedule page. Most classes require advance registration through our online booking system, which you'll receive access to when you sign up for membership. Drop-in classes are also available for select sessions.

What should I bring to class?

Please bring your own yoga mat, although we have mats available to borrow if needed. Wear comfortable clothing that allows you to move freely. We recommend bringing a water bottle to stay hydrated during class.

Do you offer beginner classes?

Yes! We offer classes for all levels, including beginner-friendly sessions. Check our class schedule for difficulty levels and descriptions, or reach out to us directly to find the perfect class for you.

Can I get a trial class?

Absolutely! We offer a free trial class for new students. Fill out the contact form above or call us to schedule your first visit. We also offer a 7-day introductory pass for just $29.

What is your cancellation policy?

Class cancellations can be made up to 2 hours before class start time through our online booking system. For membership cancellations, we require 30 days written notice. Visit our pricing page for full details.

Do you offer private sessions?

Yes, we offer private one-on-one yoga sessions with our instructors. These can be customized to your needs and goals. Contact us directly for pricing and availability.
